---
title: "Citing Bambi"
---

If you use Bambi in your work, please cite our paper in the
[Journal of Statistical Software](https://doi.org/10.18637/jss.v103.i15):

Capretto, T., Piho, C., Kumar, R., Westfall, J., Yarkoni, T., & Martin, O. A. (2022).
Bambi: A Simple Interface for Fitting Bayesian Linear Models in Python.
*Journal of Statistical Software*, *103*(15), 1–29.
<https://doi.org/10.18637/jss.v103.i15>

## BibTeX

```bibtex
@article{Capretto2022,
    title = {Bambi: A Simple Interface for Fitting Bayesian Linear Models in Python},
    author = {Capretto, Tomás and Piho, Camen and Kumar, Ravin and Westfall, Jacob and Yarkoni, Tal and Martin, Osvaldo A},
    journal = {Journal of Statistical Software},
    year = {2022},
    volume = {103},
    number = {15},
    pages = {1--29},
    doi = {10.18637/jss.v103.i15},
    url = {https://www.jstatsoft.org/index.php/jss/article/view/v103i15}
}
```
